items.name: TRIM_RANGE

source.origin: openmixer 5d9804ad56ff packages/declarations/src/index.ts:178 TRIM_RANGE { minDb: -24, maxDb: 24, stepDb: 0.1 }, applied as the lane's head gain by packages/pipewire-native/src/mixer_rt.c:1106 (omx_fill_gain); 0 dB is the trim a channel has when none is set

items.doc: The digital input trim, in dB: the console's fine head gain, applied first in a channel's lane as a click-free ramp from the last block's gain to this one (openmixer's TRIM_RANGE, -24..+24 dB in 0.1 dB steps, spelled minDb/maxDb/stepDb there). It comes up at 0 dB, the trim a channel has when none is set. omx-dsp's trim face takes it as `trim_db`.
